ValidationRule.description: Prevents unauthorized users from changing Opportunity Stage once Booking Verification has been reached, for Standard and Framework Opportunities only. Booking Verification Access covers Stage changes out of Booking Verification/Booked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity" ), OR( AND( OR( PRIORVALUE(StageName) = "Booking Verification", PRIORVALUE(StageName) = "Booked" ), NOT($Permission.Booking_Verification_Access) ), AND( OR( PRIORVALUE(StageName) = "Setup", PRIORVALUE(StageName) = "Closed", PRIORVALUE(StageName) = "Lost" ), NOT($Permission.Downstream_Stage_Progression) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Opportunity has reached a restricted stage and its Stage can no longer be changed by Sellers.
